repetitive_inauthentic_content.name: Repetitive & Inauthentic Content Policy
repetitive_inauthentic_content.description: Prevents mass-produced, repetitive script formulas, robotic voiceovers without value-add, or template spam.
check_points: Script must feature distinct, tailored analysis/reasons for each anime.
Script must avoid identical structural patterns reused across consecutive videos.
Spoken narration must sound natural and conversational.
forbidden_phrases: smash that like button right now or else

reused_content.name: Reused & Copyrighted Content Policy
reused_content.description: Requires original commentary, educational framing, or fair-use editorial presentation without using raw episode footage or manga scans.
check_points: Visuals must use official promotional key visuals or posters.
No raw anime episode video clips or pirated manga scans.
Substantial original audio narration must be present throughout the video.

misleading_metadata.name: Misleading Metadata & Clickbait Policy
misleading_metadata.description: Ensures title, description, thumbnail visual, and tags accurately describe the featured anime.
check_points: Featured anime titles must be mentioned accurately in the description.
Title must reflect the specific Short concept type.

copyright_rights_verification.name: Asset Rights & License Status
copyright_rights_verification.description: Ensures every visual image and audio file has verified source attribution and legal usage clearance.
check_points: Image assets must be official promotional posters or public domain visuals.
Background music must be royalty-free or public domain audio.
Assets with unclear or unknown rights must be flagged and blocked.

ai_synthetic_content_disclosure.name: AI & Synthetic Content Transparency
ai_synthetic_content_disclosure.description: Ensures compliance with YouTube requirements for disclosing AI-generated voiceover and synthetic scripts.
check_points: Description must include synthetic media disclosure note where required.
